query:
SELECT
    signal.id AS "signal_chunk_id!",
    signal.organization_id AS "organization_id!",
    signal.account_id AS "account_id!",
    a.name AS "account_name!",
    a.website AS "account_website?",
    signal.source_reference AS "source_reference?",
    signal.content AS "content!: JsonValue",
    signal.created_at AS "created_at!"
FROM account_signal_feed_items feed
INNER JOIN account_research_chunks signal
    ON signal.id = feed.signal_chunk_id
   AND signal.superseded_by IS NULL
INNER JOIN accounts a
    ON a.id = signal.account_id
WHERE feed.organization_id = $1
  AND feed.is_classified = TRUE
  AND (
        cardinality($2::text[]) = 0
        OR feed.display_bucket = ANY($2::text[])
      )
  AND ($3::date IS NULL OR feed.published_at_date >= $3)
  AND ($4::date IS NULL OR feed.published_at_date <= $4)
ORDER BY
  feed.published_at_date DESC NULLS LAST,
  feed.created_at DESC,
  feed.signal_chunk_id DESC
LIMIT $5
OFFSET $6
